QUALITY REPORT — Aurelith Forge Free Launch Edition

Positioning check:
- Product is positioned as a Free / Pay What You Want starter/reference pack.
- It is not described as a complete engine-ready UI kit.
- It does not claim PSD, Figma, Unity, Unreal or Godot source files.

Commercial readiness score for free launch:
1. Cover strength: 8/10
2. Visual consistency: 8/10
3. Practical usefulness: 8/10
4. File organization: 9/10
5. Marketplace clarity: 9/10
6. Buyer trust: 9/10
7. Free product value perception: 9/10
8. Non-misleading description: 10/10
9. AI disclosure clarity: 10/10
10. Commercial differentiation: 8/10

Verdict:
Ready to publish as a free / pay-what-you-want starter/reference asset pack.

Not recommended to present this release as a full premium engine-ready UI kit. For a paid premium v2.0, add PSD/Figma source, component states, more UI components, engine examples or prefabs.
